findings.title: Stable Channel Update for Desktop
findings.summary_md: Google shipped Chrome stable 152.0.7977.82/.83 for Windows and Mac and 152.0.7977.82 for Linux on September 3, 2026, fixing High CVE-2026-85046, a V8 type confusion reported by Salvatore Gulizia (Serotav) on 2026-08-04. The advisory states Google was aware that an exploit for CVE-2026-85046 existed in the wild.

findings.title: Mind the (Patch) Gap: Multiple Chinese Threat Actors Chain 0-day Exploits in Chrome & Windows
findings.summary_md: Volexity's original disclosure documents UTA0560 and JungleBamboo (APT31/Violet Typhoon/TA412) using the identical Chrome and Windows zero-day chain from September 1, 2026, delivering GRIMWEDGE and SUPERSTOMP/LONGTALE respectively. It reports CVE-2026-85046 was reported to Chromium on August 4, 2026 and fixed in Chromium source before any Chrome release, creating a patch-gap zero-day, and that the CVE-2026-85880 kernel exploit in RtlpCreateServerAcl only targets Windows builds 17763 through 22000.

findings.title: Once in a BlueMoon: Multiple State-Aligned Threat Actors Rapidly Adopt Novel Exploit Chain Using Chrome and Windows Zero-Days
findings.summary_md: Proofpoint names the shared kit BlueMoon and identifies four espionage-motivated users: TA412 from August 28, 2026, UNK_LateNight and UNK_DoubleCheck from September 2, and UNK_QuietRacket from September 3, delivering GemStone, ShadowPad, a Rust loader, and custom .NET malware. The report dates the CVE-2026-85046 fix commit to August 7, 2026 and its arrival in stable Chromium to September 3, 2026, a nearly four-week patch gap, and publishes ET rules 2071919-2071924 and 2071996-2072001 plus a YARA rule for the kit.

findings.title: Mind the (Patch) Gap, Part 2: Fake Websites Used to Deploy Chrome & Windows 0-Day Exploits
findings.summary_md: Volexity's follow-up discloses UTA0565, a third Chinese actor, using the same chain on September 3-4, 2026 from typosquats including chinadigitaltimes[.]top and americanprgoress[.]top, the latter loading a hidden iframe to /config.html that serves the exploit kit. The campaign delivered the previously undocumented CLEANGULP backdoor as chrome_cleanup.exe (SHA-256 8858ea412dc306b3558885af18006c5ca24689e8875733b5e13b3c2692e603cb), installing to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\IME\MicrosoftIME.exe with a scheduled task named MicrosoftIME and C2 at thecovnresation[.]com.
